QuestInfo.name: Korean Folk Town : Through the Ocean
QuestInfo.0: How about going to the Korean Folk Town through the ocean?
QuestInfo.1: Through Camila's request, I have decided to travel to Korean Folk Town through the ocean and meet her pen pal, Kong Ji. Camila said she'll give me a few essential items for the trip. What must those be?
QuestInfo.2: Through Camila's request, I have decided to travel to Korean Folk Town through the ocean and meet her pen pal, Kong Ji. Okay, so I first go from #bEllinia#k to #bOrbis#k, then from #bOrbis Tower#k all the way down to #bAqua Road#k? I think she told me to take the #bDolphin Taxi#k at Aquarium...

yes.0: Okay, now I'll tell you how to get to Korean Folk Town underwater. First, head over to the station in #bEllinia#k. The ship that heads to #bOrbis#k should leave every 15 minutes. Once at Orbis, head over to #bOrbis Tower#k and make your way all the way down to the 1st floor, which should be right at the ground level.
yes.1: You can enter #bAqua Road#k through the #bbasement of Orbis Tower#k. Navigate your way through Aqua Road and you'll find #bAquarium#k, a town that is completely underwater. Once there, you'll find #bDolphin Taxi#k, which should take you to the nearest spot from the Korean Folk Town.
yes.2: Talk to me once more, so I can give you all the necessary items for the travel.

no.0: Please let me know when you're ready.

1.0: This ticket will enable you to get on board for the flight. Please use it wisely.
